source: InboundConnectionIdleTimeoutIntegrationTest's shouldNotCloseConnectTunnelThatHasSwitchedProtocols and shouldNotCloseConnectTunnelWhileAResponseIsDelayedBehindAnAbandonedRequest (b765b8271). An empty httpError abandons its exchange and leaves the connection open, and the requests pipelined behind it (or sent later) are still answered; any 101 response written makes the connection long-lived (HttpExchangeTracker), directly or inside a CONNECT tunnel. Each tcp step reads for two seconds after its last chunk: closed means the server closed it within them

steps.note: a delayed response pipelined behind an abandoned request is answered; then idle
a request sent after an abandoned one is answered
the same inside a CONNECT tunnel
a 101 response makes the connection long-lived: it stays open past the timeout

GET /upgrade HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:{{port}}
Connection: Upgrade
Upgrade: custom
